cards.prompt: On an empty stomach, what should you eat before carbs?
A study found eating carbs first on an empty stomach released ____ more sugar into the blood than the reverse order.
The order in which you eat food does not matter, only what you eat.
cards.answer: Myth: food order has a significant impact on blood sugar response.

cards.prompt: Which habit is linked to lower post-meal glucose levels?
cards.answer: Taking whey protein before the meal reduces glucose after the meal.

cards.prompt: You wake up hungry and your breakfast has toast, eggs and a salad. How should you order it, and why?
cards.answer: Eat eggs (protein) and salad (fiber) first, toast last; carbs first on an empty stomach spike blood sugar much more.

cards.prompt: Order a meal to limit blood sugar spikes.
